import z3
W = 8
G = 10
S = 3
P = G * S  # 30
N = W * P  # 240
group = [[z3.Int(f'g_{w}_{p}') for p in range(P)] for w in range(W)]
s = z3.Solver()
for w in range(W):
    for p in range(P):
        s.add(group[w][p] >= 0, group[w][p] < G)
for w in range(W):
    for g in range(G):
        s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(group[w][p] == g, 1, 0) for p in range(P)]) == S)
for p1 in range(P):
    for p2 in range(p1+1, P):
        together = []
        for w in range(W):
            together.append(z3.And(group[w][p1] == group[w][p2], group[w][p1] >= 0))
        s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(t, 1, 0) for t in together]) <= 1)
print('Constraints added, variables:', N)
print('Number of constraints roughly:', s.num_constraints()) # may not be accurate
status = s.check()
print(status)
